title: SimCity 99 — Graphics Quality Roadmap (10 milestones to SC2K fidelity)
goal: Raise the game's procedural art from 37/100 to the SimCity 2000 fidelity bar defined in docs/graphics-quality-rubric.json — a vibrant, sunny 1997-nostalgia isometric city that reads instantly as a colorful topographic mosaic — recreated ENTIRELY in procedural canvas (zero external art, zero dependencies, no build step). Clean-room: recreate the look and quality, never copy Maxis art. Work the milestones below top-to-bottom; each is completed by a dynamic workflow and must clear its quality gates before it ships. REFINED BAR (user-directed): the benchmark is original SimCity 2000 fidelity PLUS tasteful modern presentation norms (see rubric.modern_norms) — high-DPI crispness, smooth camera feel, colorblind-legible overlays, minor balance corrections. Modern norms are cross-cutting gates on every milestone; dedicated work lives in GQ11.
scoring_baseline: The SUMMER / DAYTIME render is the reference baseline for all gates.

loop_protocol.driver: /goal + /loop — each loop iteration picks the first milestone whose status != done and runs it to completion via a dynamic workflow, then ships and advances.
per_milestone_workflow: 1. DESIGN+CRITERIA — an independent reviewer agent turns this milestone's quality_gates into a concrete, measurable pass spec and an implementation design against the actual codebase (render.js/sprites.js/sim.js).
2. IMPLEMENT — an agent makes the procedural-canvas changes on the feature branch.
3. VERIFY — a headless Playwright harness (seeded-LCG determinism, HEAD-baseline worktree) measures every quality gate; pixel/byte-level where possible.
4. PANEL — a multi-vote adversarial panel (diverse lenses: fidelity, regression, determinism, performance) tries to refute the gates; real defects are fixed and re-verified.
5. SHIP — only when all gates pass and the panel confirms: rebuild the single-file bundle, republish the artifact, update MILESTONES.md + this file's status, commit, push.
invariants: Every visual change is measured against a pinned HEAD baseline; sprite/geometry changes that must stay byte-identical are proven so.
Determinism: same seed → identical output (seeded RNG streams, no per-frame Math.random in bakes).
No regression to shipped systems: night legibility (G1/G2), seasons (G12/G14), rotation (M32a/b), day/night, save format, painter order, click-picking.
Performance: developed-128 median frame stays within ~20% of baseline; bakes are cached, never per-frame.

stretch_deferred.title: True elevation heightmap
stretch_deferred.why_deferred: Integer per-tile elevation with cliffs + sea-level water pooling is an effort-5 epic that invalidates the flat painter order (s=x+y), height-ambiguous click-picking, the single-blit terrain cache, updateCars/minimap re-basing, multi-tile footprint leveling, a save-format bump + migration, and must reconcile with the categorical TERR.WATER model, waterfill, pump adjacency and the M29 flood. Explicitly OUT of the 10-milestone near-term bar; revisit only after GQ1-10 are done.

milestones.title: Daytime palette & water vibrancy
milestones.scope: Push summer/noon facade + terrain saturation to full; tune NIGHT_MAX_ALPHA / the night-lerp so no sampled frame collapses to cold monochrome; add a two-tone water dither + sine-scroll highlight; lift winter water (#9fc1d9) toward cobalt. A lighting-constant + HSL re-tune — NOT a default flip (day/night already exists, default-on).
quality_gates: Summer/noon render: water HSL saturation >= 60% and the most saturated blue in the frame.
Average daytime frame saturation >= 2x the deepest night frame.
Night render still shows warm accent pixels on a visible fraction of facades (no single-cold-hue frame).
Parks/trees render vivid mid-green (S >= 45%) in daytime.
Geometry/sprite silhouettes byte-identical to HEAD (color-only change); zero console errors.
milestones.certified: 2026-07-23: all 5 gates pass (water median HSL S 70.2% + most saturated blue in frame; day/night 4.07x vs deepest night frame; 82% of midnight towers keep warm accents; park green S 46-59%; all 593 sprite alpha masks byte-identical to baseline 368d514). 3-lens adversarial panel 0 refutes; panel-found med defect (pre-existing #3555ff zone-marker out-bluing the lake) fixed to #4860e0 and re-verified.

milestones.title: Ground-material quilt
milestones.scope: Assign every empty tile a material (grass/dirt/sand/pavement) via low-frequency value noise, drawn with a base color + stippled/dithered noise so no flat slab fills remain; add directional/relief tonal variation so the plane never reads as one flat tone.
quality_gates: >= 4 distinct ground materials visible in one view, each with per-tile noise (adjacent same-type tiles differ measurably).
No flat-fill slab region larger than a set NxN block of identical pixels.
Ground reads as varied color/texture at both 1.0 and ~0.4 zoom.
Terrain cache still rebuilds only on season/size change (no per-frame cost); developed-128 frame within ~20% of baseline.
Deterministic (same seed -> identical ground); zero console errors.
milestones.certified: 2026-07-23: all gates pass vs baseline 10909f1. 4 materials in view (grass 412/dirt 26/sand 57/pave 20 tiles; pair color distance 52.9-123); after the panel-driven fix (8 independent bakes per material, 4 variants x 2 parity) ALL 616 adjacent same-material pairs differ >=15.97% (was 35 pairs <5%); largest identical-RGBA square 2x2 px; rebuild cadence identical to HEAD with cost ratio 0.97-1.00x (mirror-transform removal erased the 1.44x spike); building sprites + save + 60-tick sim byte-identical; correct at all 4 rotations; zero errors. Panel: fidelity refute resolved by the fix; determinism/regression lenses confirm.

milestones.title: Zone-correlated building palette
milestones.scope: Seed each facade base color from a curated zone/density palette (terracotta/brick-red R, tan/mustard mid-rise, cream/white civic, teal/cyan + banded glass C, drab steel/olive I); derive lit/shadow faces by HSL lightness shift.
quality_gates: >= 6 distinct facade hue buckets spanning red, orange/tan, gold, teal/cyan, blue, neutral-white.
A nearest-hue classifier over sampled R/C/I tiles is >= 0.9 zone-correct.
Adjacent same-variant tiles differ by >= 10 color distance.
Night window glow + G1 legibility bake preserved (night frame unregressed).
Deterministic; zero console errors.
milestones.certified: 2026-07-23: clean pass, 8/8 criteria vs baseline 1a7e8d1, no fix needed. 7 hue buckets present (terracotta/brick R, tan/mustard+gold mid-rise, teal/cyan + banded blue glass C, olive/steel I, neutral-white civic); nearest-hue classifier 90/90 = 1.00 zone-correct at cam.r=0 AND r=1; min adjacent-variant color distance 11.7 (>=10); all 58 night+pool glow canvases byte-identical (G1 preserved), glow ratio 1.048; 647 unrelated day canvases byte-identical; 2868 canvas hashes identical across independent boots (deterministic); winter<=summer saturation holds. Panel 3/3 confirm, 0 refutes (3 low taste notes only). c3 towers gained period-correct banded curtain-wall + mullions with zero ART_RNG drift.

milestones.title: Vegetation & street trees
milestones.scope: Cluster dense multi-tile tree stands on unbuilt tiles and line single street trees along >= 70% of straight road segments, with size/hue jitter. Placement-only — the summer-green tree recolor already shipped.
quality_gates: >= 1 multi-tile dense tree stand renders on unbuilt land.
Street trees present along >= 70% of straight road segments (measured).
Trees never illegally overlap building footprints/roads; placement is legal and deterministic.
Perf: tree draw reuses the baked sprite; developed-128 frame within ~20% of baseline.
Deterministic; zero console errors.
milestones.certified: 2026-07-23: 8/8 criteria vs baseline 1caa0a3 + panel high-defect fixed and fully re-verified. Street trees: deterministic pure function of (seed,x,y)+roadMask on straight road tiles (~89% coverage, gate 70%), drawn in the painter loop at the TRUE grass verge (+-0.44, outside the +-0.36 asphalt span — the panel caught trees standing on the pavement at +-0.34 and the fix moved them), trunk 1.6px clear of the curb; 0 legality violations incl. water-bridge/intersection/burning adversarial fixtures; correct at all 4 rotations (12/12); autumn spreads 2/2/2 gold/orange/red; variants consistent across seasons; tight 20x22 bake canvas cut blit area 9x -> developed-128 with 1818 trees at 1.16-1.17x (gate 1.20); empty-city frame + 537 bake hashes + night layer + save round-trip byte-identical; deterministic; zero errors. Dense stands: existing 922-tile forest verified rendering (21/25 foliage). 7-agent workflow, 3-lens panel.

milestones.title: Building silhouette variety
milestones.scope: Build 3-4 non-prism massings from stacked/inset iso boxes (stepped-setback mid-rise, tapering tower, pitched/hip-roof low-rise, wide sawtooth-roof industrial shed) plus a 6+ rooftop prop library with seeded placement. The top 'reads as SC2K' lever.
quality_gates: >= 12 archetypes distinguishable by grayscale silhouette OUTLINE alone (not 12 barely-different boxes).
Density levels 1-5 produce distinct sprites (setbacks/tapering at high density).
Rooftops draw from >= 6 prop types with seeded per-tile placement so neighbors differ.
Sprite anchors/footprints unchanged -> painter order + click-picking round-trip intact vs HEAD baseline.
Deterministic; zero console errors.
milestones.certified: 2026-07-23: 8/8 criteria vs pinned baseline e640d18, Playwright/Chromium headless (worktree on :8972 beside the working tree on :8971), cross-checked by a deterministic software-raster harness. 12 declared archetypes (r1[0] cottages, r2[0] hip rowhouse, r3[0] asymmetric wedding-cake, c1[0] storefront, c2[0] podium+offset slab, c3[0] tapering 3-tier tower, c3[1] crown-step+mast tower, i1[0] gable shed, i2[0] sawtooth shed, i2[1] box+stack, i3[0] heavy plant, r3[1] off-center tank-crown tower): 64-col height-normalized alpha-outline distance min 0.0492 / median 0.120 over all 66 pairs (floor 0.045; HEAD min ~0.000). Consecutive-level distances 0.066-0.143 (gate 0.05); bbox heights strictly increasing per zone (R 32/72/95, C 51/87/127, I 51/70/98); r3[0] plateaus 6 (gate 3); c3[0] taper 0.594 (gate 0.72). ROOF_PROPS=8 types, seeded per (BR,family,variant,jitIndex); min jit-pair prop-diff 136-194 px (gate 120, HEAD 0); in-situ adjacent same-variant tiles differ at 2410 px. Dims/anchors tuple-equal 756/756 across 4 facings; pick round-trip 1200/1200 identical; unchanged-families frame toDataURL byte-equal. Byte-identity: 1552 canvases of the untouched set (r1/c1/i3/park/10 civics/7 landmarks/terrain/roads/rail/pipe/wire, 4 facings, all seasons) hash-equal to HEAD - the school/hospital/mayor/stadium equality doubles as the shared 0x5EED stream canary. Math.random-stubbed double-boot: 2892/2892 canvases identical; 3 static frames identical in one waterFrame bucket. Scripted session (all zone/lvl/varnt combos, 48 ticks, night, 4 rotations, billboard toggle, save+load): 0 console/page errors. Changed-family night bakes 92-646 lit px, 100% inside 3px-dilated day mask. Frame time 0.93x HEAD (gate 1.15x); boot median 1.02x (gate 1.5x). Harnesses: scratchpad gq5_browser_cert.mjs + gq5_cert.mjs/rasterctx.js (not shipped).

milestones.title: Reflective-glass facades
milestones.scope: A new bake routine drawing PERIOD-CORRECT ordered-dithered / horizontally-banded curtain-wall + vertical mullions + a couple of reflection streaks (256-color-era glass, NOT a smooth modern top-to-bottom gradient). Applied to commercial high-density towers.
quality_gates: Glass facades show horizontal banding / ordered dither (measured: not a smooth vertical gradient; palette-quantized).
Vertical mullion lines present on glass towers.
Applied only to commercial high-density towers (zone/density-gated).
Silhouette + anchor unchanged vs the GQ5 sprite output.
Deterministic; zero console errors.
milestones.certified: 2026-07-23: clean pass 6/6 vs baseline 7299590, 0 refutes, no fix needed. c3 glass elevated to certified reflective 90s curtain-wall: palette-quantized banding (clusters<=10, >=10 luminance transitions, smooth-pair fraction ~0.05 — provably NOT a gradient), in-band ordered dither (2 dominant tones >=92% coverage, 11 alternations), mullions 97-100% column-exact at t=1/3,2/3 on both faces of all 5 variants, and 203-397 px of diagonal reflection glints per variant that cross spandrel+glass (reads as reflection, not stripes). Scope surgical: of 14,884 audited canvas paths, only the 200 allowed c3-day-lineage canvases differ; every non-c3 family byte-identical; silhouette/anchors unchanged; deterministic across fresh contexts AND with UNSTUBBED Math.random (glassRng side stream only); zero errors.

milestones.title: Road markings & asphalt
milestones.scope: Darken road fill to asphalt; bake dashed center-lines, solid lane edges and intersection crosswalk/stop-line bars into all 16 autotile mask orientations so they still read correctly after the rot4() remap.
quality_gates: Straight tiles draw dashed center-line + lane edges; intersections draw crosswalk/stop-line bars.
Markings correct across all 4 camera rotations (rot4 mask remap verified per orientation).
Daytime asphalt is darker than lot fill so the network reads as a grid.
Night lamp compositing + car animation unchanged; traffic not regressed; all 16 masks + winter variants bake at the unchanged anchor.
Deterministic; zero console errors.

milestones.title: Building cast-shadows & aliveness guard
milestones.scope: Add a directional building drop-shadow pass onto neighbor tiles (matching the tree/car grounding shadows already in render.js), and formalize aliveness (traffic density, smoke plumes, animated water/train) as a regression-guarded target.
quality_gates: Buildings cast a directional drop-shadow onto adjacent tiles (measured shadow pixels in the sun-opposite direction).
Shadow direction consistent with the existing tree/car grounding shadows.
Aliveness instrumented and >= HEAD baseline: traffic density, smoke plumes, animated water and train all present (guard test).
Shadows are day-only and do not bleed into the night glow layer.
Deterministic; zero console errors.

milestones.title: Shorelines & suspension bridges
milestones.scope: Render a beveled beach/foam ramp on every land-water border (no hard 1px seam) with a distinct lighter foam/wet-sand band; and auto-span a procedural suspension bridge when road/rail abuts a TERR.WATER run (tapered towers, quadratic main cable, evenly spaced hangers, railed deck quad, translucent water shadow). Flat-water model — no elevation needed.
quality_gates: Every land tile bordering water renders a beveled beach/foam ramp — no hard 1px edge (measured luma transition).
A distinct lighter foam/wet-sand transition band is present.
Road/rail crossing a flat TERR.WATER gap renders a bridge with towers + cable + hangers + deck.
Bridge + shoreline render correctly across all 4 rotations; picking/traffic through the bridge intact.
Save format unchanged (visual-only); zero console errors.

milestones.title: Special buildings gap-fill
milestones.scope: Surface & tune the shipped M28 landmarks (arcologies/statue/eiffel/pyramid/stadium/civics), then author only the genuinely-missing silhouettes: an airport group (terminal + control tower + runway/apron markings), a second visually-distinct power-plant type, and >= 1 water-edge seaport/marina. Each with a signature accent hue.
quality_gates: M28 landmark family renders distinctly: >= 8 non-prism special silhouettes readable in play (incl. >= 1 hero landmark readable at 0.3 zoom).
New airport group renders (terminal + control tower + runway markings) and is placeable/tier-gated.
Second power-plant type is visually distinct AND wired into power supply (sim-correct capacity/aging).
A seaport/marina places on or adjacent to water tiles and renders a water-edge structure.
New building ids save-round-trip; each special carries a signature accent hue; zero console errors.

milestones.title: Modern presentation & balance polish
milestones.scope: The dedicated modern-norms pass (user-directed addendum): (a) devicePixelRatio-aware canvas backing store so all pixel art renders crisp on retina/mobile while DPR=1 output stays byte-identical; (b) eased zoom-to-cursor / pinch-midpoint camera interpolation; (c) colorblind-legibility pass over all seven minimap/data modes (hue paired with lightness or pattern); (d) a balance-correction audit: soak-test the economy/demand loops for degenerate states and apply minimal documented fixes.
quality_gates: At DPR=2 the rendered scene is measurably sharper than the DPR-ignorant baseline (no canvas upscale blur); at DPR=1 output is byte-identical to before.
Zoom eases smoothly toward the cursor/pinch midpoint (no visual snap); mobile pinch remains glitch-free; desktop mouse behavior otherwise unchanged.
All seven minimap modes remain distinguishable under a deuteranopia simulation matrix (hue never the sole channel).
A 100-year soak run surfaces no degenerate economy state (funds runaway, permanently dead demand, free-money loop); any fix is minimal, documented, and byte-safe for unaffected saves.
Zero regressions: rotation, seasons, night, save round-trip, perf within ~20%; zero console errors.

modern_norms_gates: No milestone may regress high-DPI crispness once MN1 lands (GQ11 or earlier).
New overlay/minimap art must not rely on hue alone (MN3).
Any balance tweak shipped alongside art must be minimal, documented in the milestone notes, and verified byte-safe for saves it should not affect (MN5).
